sections: 1. AND gate — c) Multiplication of inputs (A·B)

2. Circuit: inputs A and B feed a 2-input AND gate; the AND output and input C feed a 2-input OR gate; OR output = F.

3. Real-life example — car seatbelt warning: buzzer = (ignition ON) AND (seatbelt NOT fastened) OR (door OPEN). Uses AND (ignition·belt̅), NOT (belt status inverted), and OR (adds door condition) together.
